title: The Donkey's Shoes
summary: Nasruddin had his donkey shod with four brand new iron shoes. As they trotted down the cobblestone street, the shoes rang out: Clink, clank, clink!...
full_text:
Nasruddin had his donkey shod with four brand new iron shoes. As they trotted down the cobblestone street, the shoes rang out: Clink, clank, clink!

Nasruddin leaned over and patted the beast: "Now you walk like a general! Mind you don't grow too proud to carry my cabbage baskets!"
moral: Tend to the tools and creatures that bear your burdens.
